positive_direction_definition: relative wheel rotation about body +X by the right-hand rule

prediction.sign_prediction_basis: The raw TIM2 counter polarity for the project-defined body +X right-hand-rule direction is intentionally unknown. Legacy reaction-wheel counting behavior is useful historical evidence but does not bind raw counter polarity to the current physical coordinate convention.

forbidden_interpretations: Do not promote legacy reaction-wheel encoder line count directly as STM32 counts per mechanical revolution.
Do not infer physical sign from legacy software variable naming or control algebra.
Do not infer encoder_max_abs_delta_counts_per_sample from slow manual rotation.
Do not change estimator, controller, or actuator signs to make the capture look expected.
